documents.title: COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATE FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30Th, 2026.
COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATE FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30Th, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Modis Navnirman Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, highlighting year-on-year growth in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax. Management discussed ongoing project executions, expansion into new micro-markets like Santacruz and Khar through an asset-light redevelopment model, and stable demand trends in Mumbai real estate. The company also addressed the impact of material cost pressures during the quarter and outlined its upcoming project pipeline. Modis Navnirman Limited reported a strong financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations growing by 27.9% year-on-year to ₹58.26 crore and PAT rising by 25.8% to ₹8.54 crore. Construction progressed steadily across ongoing projects such as Rashmi Square, Rashmi Signature, Rashmi Delight, Rashmi Manorath, Rashmi Icon, and Rashmi Avenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Median age of 29 years is driving housing demand in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Median Age: 29 years driving housing demand

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that housing demand remains strong in micro-markets like Kandivali, Borivali, Malad, Goregaon, and Dahisar.
demand_outlook.quote: Our performance reflects the strength of our redevelopment-focused model, disciplined project execution and our ability to identify attractive opportunities in micro-markets where housing demand remains strong.

capex_expansion.claim: The total portfolio consists of six ongoing projects, 14 completed projects, and five upcoming projects.
capex_expansion.quote: Together with this, currently we have six ongoing projects and 14 completed projects, and five upcoming projects across Bombay and its region, taking our portfolio to 25 premium residential projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully secured a new redevelopment project during Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: The quarter marked another important milestone for the Company with the successful securing of another new redevelopment project.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired new projects named Rashmi Shetal and Rashmi Gold.
capex_expansion.quote: Upcoming projects include Rashmi Shetal and Rashmi Gold which we have recently acquired.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects healthy margins of around 20% to 30% from redevelopment projects depending on the scheme used.
margins_costs.quote: But a healthy margins of around 20% to 30% should be expected in every project.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations increased by 27.9% to ₹58.26 crore in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: “Modis Navnirman Limited delivered a strong performance in Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations increasing by 27.9% to %58.26 crore, while EBITDA grew by 14.2% to X11.65 crore and PAT rose by 25.8% to X8.54 crore, reflecting disciplined execution, operational efficiency, and the strength of the Company's redevelopment-led business model.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit margin percentage for Q1 FY27 was 23.62%.
EBITDA margin percentage including other income was 19.83% for Q1 FY27.
PAT margin percentage for Q1 FY27 stood at 14.54%.
Management noted that margins saw some moderation due to project mix, execution, and ongoing construction expenses associated with larger projects.
margins_costs.quote: While margins saw some moderation due to project mix and execution and ongoing construction expenses associated with larger projects, we believe this is temporary and our long-term margin profile remains healthy.

orders_capacity.claim: The area sold during Q1 FY27 reached approximately 44,000 square feet.
orders_capacity.quote: One number I want to specifically mention is the area sold, which in Q1 FY27, we have sold around 44,000 square feet.

orders_capacity.claim: Execution progress across ongoing projects includes slabs completed for Rashmi Square, Rashmi Signature, Rashmi Delight, and Rashmi Manorath.
orders_capacity.quote: Rashmi Square has completed 22 slabs. Rashmi Signature completed its 20th slab. Rashmi Delight completed its 14th slab, and Rashmi Manorath completed its 13th slab.

orders_capacity.claim: Total area sold in Q1 FY27 was 44,000 sq. ft.
The company's total project portfolio consists of 7.5 lakh square feet, out of which 4.92 is booked and 2.40 lakh available inventory.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total project portfolio consists of 7.5 lakh square feet, out of which 4.92 is booked and 2.40 lakh available inventory.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the company remains debt-free despite rapid growth.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still debt-free despite rapid growth. We continue to maintain our debt-free model.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements involve risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially.
risks_headwinds.quote: These forward-looking statements involve a number of risks, uncertainties and other factors that could cause actual results to differ materially from those suggested by the forward-looking statements.

risks_headwinds.claim: Important developments that could affect operations include changes in industry structure, political and economic environment, tax laws, import duties, litigation, and labor.
risks_headwinds.quote: Important developments that could affect the Company’s operations include changes in the industry structure, significant changes in political and economic environment in India and overseas, tax laws, import duties, litigation and labor.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that war situations have impacted raw material prices to a minor extent.
risks_headwinds.quote: So in terms of the war situation has impacted us, but not majorly because currently the execution stage which is at this level, the raw material impact is at a lower level to us.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains focused on accelerating project execution, selectively expanding the redevelopment portfolio, maintaining financial discipline, and delivering sustainable value for all stakeholders.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we remain focused on accelerating project execution, selectively expanding our redevelopment portfolio, maintaining financial discipline, and delivering sustainable value for all stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that Rashmi Square will be delivered in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We will be delivering that project in FY27. This year we'll be delivering Rashmi Square.

management_commitments.claim: Management affirmed that margins will bounce back to previous levels.
management_commitments.quote: No, no, we'll bounce back to our previous levels.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
